The kid-focused on-ear headphones feature an 85-decibel volume limit and easy controls, and a mode that lets them beam audio (wired or wirelessly) to a second pair without extra hardware. Readers can use the code VERGE25OFF to save 25 percent on up to two pairs of SoundForm Mini 2 headphones. The $29.99 model without the zip-up carrying case gets knocked down to $22.49. Alternatively, a more limited selection of colors are currently available that include a case, which is $29.99 instead of $39.99 once the offer code is applied in the cart. They can last up to 55 hours on a single change, and they can fold up neatly to fit into a variety of bags. The SoundForm Mini 2 are made for ages 3 and up, and feature an adjustable headband and cushioned earcups.
